Added some documentation

Removed conditional check, instead I'm supplying env variable for testing.

Easier to test the release

Tweaked 1st release step so that the entire release procedure is easier to test

Tidied up the release logic

- reworked the conditional complexity to avoid accidental releases
- removed custom release version logic because it does not work (not opposed to this feature, just cleaned up the code)
- for the time being, custom version can be achieved by using Gradle env variable: ORG_GRADLE_PROJECT_version=2.3.0 (it looks like magic but it is a real feature from the Gradle book ;)

Temporarily disabled automatic maven central sync

Will reenable once the release procedure is smooth

Updated version so that we stop producing betas

Mockito continuously delivers high quality enhancements with every change
Made release procedure easier to test
